No live class

A big decision with no first step

Right now someone who loves your reels goes from a 60-second clip straight to “Let’s work together”, with no hour in the room with you first. That’s a big jump for anyone outside a pro locker room.

The stage

Your best room only exists on the day

When you speak, a whole room gets the full Coach Dar experience. Online, there’s no repeatable version of that room, so the people who’d feel it most never get to.

Reach

Coaching only travels as far as a reel

Your last 7 reels landed between 2,034 and 4,698 views, steady but all under 5k. With 42.9k followers, most of your audience doesn’t see a given post, and nothing is pushing it further.

The leaders and athletes who need your mental edge are already watching. There’s no moment yet that lets them raise their hand.

My recommendation

A free live class built on The Art of Bouncing Back, that finds your next coaching clients

Your book is already your low-ticket offer, so the class itself should be free. A Mental Edge Playbook on the thank-you page earns from day one and pays for the ads, and the class does the job a reel can’t: it puts people in the room with you.

Fixes the missing first step

An hour with you, free, is the easiest yes for anyone who’s felt the pressure. They see how you coach, and every sign-up is an email you keep.

Puts your stage online

The class is your keynote energy, live, for anyone who signs up. Run it on a schedule and the room fills itself every month.

Fills the middle and pays for ads

The Playbook gives people something to buy between the book and coaching, and those sales cover the ad spend so your message reaches far beyond your best reel.

The 95%*

Want the edge, not ready for 1:1 yet

They join the free class and many add the Mental Edge Playbook to put it into practice. The relationship starts with a purchase, and Grit & Greatness keeps them close until they’re ready.

The qualified 5%

Leaders and performers ready now

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before a call, and the pre-call emails set the tone so they arrive ready to work.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Is this you?

You perform under pressure. Every single day.

  • You lead a team, a company or a locker room, and everyone looks to you when things get hard.
  • You’re great at your job, but a setback can stay in your head for days.
  • You prepare for everything except the mental side of the big moment.
  • You want the same mindset tools the pros use, not another pep talk.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in one hour

What the mental edge really is

Why talent gets you in the room, and what separates the people who stay there when the pressure rises.

The pre-performance routine

How to get your head right before the pitch, the board meeting or the big game, so you walk in clear instead of rattled.

How to bounce back after a setback

A simple reset you can use in the moments after a miss, so one bad play doesn’t become a bad week.

Mental fuel, every day

The small daily habits that keep your mindset strong when nobody is watching.

Leading with clarity and conviction

How to stay steady when your team is looking at you, and lead them through the hard stretch.

Meet Coach Dar

Hi, I’m Darleen Santore

Most people know me as Coach Dar. I’m a mental edge and leadership coach to athletes in the NBA, NFL, NHL and MLB, and to CEOs. I help high-performing leaders, athletes and change-makers strengthen their mindset, rise through adversity, and lead with clarity, conviction and impact.

I wrote the bestseller The Art of Bouncing Back, and every week I share mental fuel in my newsletter, Grit & Greatness. This class is where I teach the core of that work, live.
